```{r, include=FALSE}
packages <- c("duckdb", "lubridate", "tidyverse", "dplyr", "readr", "arrow", "fst", "DBI")

install_if_missing <- function(package) {
  if (!require(package, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(package, dependencies = TRUE)
    library(package, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

sapply(packages, install_if_missing)

read_data <- function(file_path) {
  if (grepl("\\.csv$", file_path)) {
    return(read.csv(file_path))
  } else if (grepl("\\.parquet$", file_path)) {
    return(arrow::read_parquet(file_path))
  } else if (grepl("\\.fst$", file_path)) {
    return(fst::read.fst(file_path))
  } else {
    stop("Unsupported file format")
  }
}

write_files_to_duckdb_optimized <- function(files, tables_location, file_type, con) {
  for (file_name in names(files)) {
    file_path <- paste0(tables_location, "/", file_name, file_type)
    table_name <- files[[file_name]]
    sql <- sprintf(
      "CREATE TABLE %s AS SELECT * FROM parquet_scan('%s')",
      table_name, file_path
    )
    dbExecute(con, sql)
    print(paste("Connected to DuckDB and wrote table:", table_name, "from", file_path))
  }
}
write_files_to_duckdb <- function(files, tables_location, file_type, con) {
  for (file_name in names(files)) {
    file_path <- paste0(tables_location, "/", file_name, file_type)
    data <- as.data.frame(read_data(file_path))
    table_name <- files[[file_name]]
    duckdb::dbWriteTable(con, table_name, data)
    print(paste("Connected to DuckDB and wrote table:", table_name, "from file:", file_name))
    rm(data)
  }
}

con <- duckdb::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), dbdir = ":memory:")
tables_location <- 'Z:/CAPriCORN_raw_ds/CAPriCORN'
output_folder <- '//cri-rss.cri.uchicago.edu/chess-lab/staff/rbaccile/Matt/output/'
file_type <- '.csv'

```

```{r }
files <- list(
  "Lab" = "lab",
  "Encounter" = "enc"
)

write_files_to_duckdb(files, tables_location, file_type, con)
```

#import all labs, filter to TSH
```{r}
df_1 <- readRDS(paste0(output_folder, "dataset_1_eligible_patients.Rds"))
duckdb::duckdb_register(con, "df_1_view", df_1)

# List of LOINC codes to filter
code_list <- c("110665-7", "3015-5", "20452-9", "55462-6", "26998-5", "29575-8", "29574-1", "69561-9", "3016-3", "3016-3", "14297-6", "11580-8", "11579-0", "24348-5")

# Build SQL IN clause
codes_sql <- paste(sprintf("'%s'", code_list), collapse = ", ")

# Get filtered and selected from cond
tsh_daily <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  sprintf(
    "
    WITH tsh_base AS (
      SELECT
        l.STUDY_ID,
        l.ENCOUNTERID,
        l.LAB_LOINC,
        CAST(l.RESULT_DATE AS DATE) AS lab_date,
        TRY_CAST(l.RESULT_NUM AS DOUBLE) AS RESULT_NUM,
        e.ENC_TYPE
      FROM lab l
      INNER JOIN df_1_view d
        ON l.STUDY_ID = d.cap_id
      INNER JOIN enc e
        ON l.ENCOUNTERID = e.ENCOUNTERID
      WHERE l.LAB_LOINC IN (%s)
    ),
    tsh_distinct AS (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        STUDY_ID,
        lab_date,
        RESULT_NUM,
        ENCOUNTERID,
        LAB_LOINC,
        ENC_TYPE
      FROM tsh_base
      WHERE RESULT_NUM IS NOT NULL
        AND RESULT_NUM <= 1000
    )
    SELECT
      STUDY_ID AS cap_id,
      MIN(LAB_LOINC) AS loinc,
      'TSH' AS lab,
      lab_date,
      AVG(RESULT_NUM) AS lab_value,
      COUNT(*) AS n_lab_values,
      MIN(ENCOUNTERID) AS lab_enc_id,
      MIN(ENC_TYPE) AS enc_type
    FROM tsh_distinct
    GROUP BY STUDY_ID, lab_date
    ORDER BY cap_id, lab_date
    ",
    codes_sql
  )
)
```

# If multiple labs within 30 day period, take the average
```{r}
duckdb::duckdb_register(con, "tsh_daily_view", tsh_daily)

tsh_summary <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "
  WITH lab_periods AS (
    SELECT
      cap_id,
      lab_date,
      lab_value,
      FLOOR(
        DATE_DIFF(
          'day',
          MIN(lab_date) OVER (PARTITION BY cap_id),
          lab_date
        ) / 30
      ) AS lab_30day_period
    FROM tsh_daily_view
  ),
  averaged_labs AS (
    SELECT
      cap_id,
      lab_30day_period,
      MIN(lab_date) AS period_start_date,
      MAX(lab_date) AS period_end_date,
      AVG(lab_value) AS avg_lab_value
    FROM lab_periods
    GROUP BY cap_id, lab_30day_period
  )
  SELECT
    cap_id,
    MIN(period_start_date) AS first_lab_date,
    MAX(period_end_date) AS last_lab_date,
    DATE_DIFF('day', MIN(period_start_date), MAX(period_end_date)) AS time_range_days,
    COUNT(*) AS n_unique_lab_values
  FROM averaged_labs
  GROUP BY cap_id
  ORDER BY cap_id
  "
)

```

# Initial filter for total time observed
```{r}
tsh_summary <- tsh_summary %>% filter(time_range_days >730 & n_unique_lab_values>=3)
tsh_daily <- left_join(tsh_summary, tsh_daily)
```

# Generate long dataset of potentially eligible unique TSH values
```{r}
duckdb::duckdb_unregister(con, "tsh_daily_view")
duckdb::duckdb_register(con, "tsh_daily_view", tsh_daily)
tsh_30day_summary <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "
  WITH filtered_labs AS (
    SELECT
      cap_id,
      lab_date,
      lab_value
    FROM tsh_daily_view
    WHERE lab_value IS NOT NULL
      AND lab_value <= 1000
  ),
  lab_periods AS (
    SELECT
      cap_id,
      lab_date,
      lab_value,
      FLOOR(
        DATE_DIFF(
          'day',
          MIN(lab_date) OVER (PARTITION BY cap_id),
          lab_date
        ) / 30
      ) AS lab_30day_period
    FROM filtered_labs
  )
  SELECT
    cap_id,
    lab_30day_period,
    MIN(lab_date) AS min_lab_date,
    MAX(lab_date) AS max_lab_date,
    AVG(lab_value) AS unique_lab_value,
    COUNT(*) AS n_labs_in_window
  FROM lab_periods
  GROUP BY cap_id, lab_30day_period
  ORDER BY cap_id, min_lab_date
  "
)

df_1 <- df_1[df_1$cap_id %in% tsh_30day_summary$cap_id,]
write.csv(
  tsh_daily,
  paste0(output_folder, "dataset_2_labs.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE)

saveRDS(df_1, paste0(output_folder, "dataset_1_cohort.Rds"))
saveRDS(tsh_daily, paste0(output_folder, "dataset_2_labs.Rds"))
saveRDS(tsh_30day_summary, paste0(output_folder, "tsh_30day_summary.Rds"))
saveRDS(tsh_summary, paste0(output_folder, "tsh_summary.Rds"))
```
